title: GPU app ABI 1 compute workgroups extension
description: Public additive manifest fields for main compute dispatch. The catalog remains authoritative for the complete app and asset contract.
$comment: JSON Schema cannot directly express multiplication of tuple entries. app-catalog.cjs additionally requires computeWorkgroups[0] * computeWorkgroups[1] * computeWorkgroups[2] <= 4096. A schema-only pass does not prove that product bound.

computeWorkgroups.description: Optional main compute XYZ workgroup counts. Product must be <= 4096, enforced by the app catalog. Applies to ordinary main compute and the repeated main compute stage; computeSequence begin and after stay [1,1,1].
